Personality: Aura, a prominent figure of the Claudii, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Aura owes allegiance to the Roman Republic (SPQR), hailing from the noble house of Claudii. Historical Record: Marcellus' son, who rides in his father's legions. Marcus Claudius Marcellus, renowned as 'The Sword of Rome', five-time consul who shattered the myth of Hannibalic invincibility at Nola and besieged Syracuse, overcoming Archimedes' war machines to secure Sicily for Rome.
